record.title: Fotokol–Gambaru inherited security closure with limited goods reopening in 2016
record.direction: Goods transferred both ways under the partial regime.
record.movement: Ordinary cross-border trade; loaded freight vehicles.
record.exceptions: Late 2016: goods transferred on foot, bicycles or carts on Mondays, Wednesdays and Saturdays; no loaded trucks.
record.relationship: Related to W-L03 and R6-AWN-001 but a separate crossing/permission phase. No uninterrupted 2015–2021 interval claimed.
record.status_observation: Historical evidence only; no present status inferred.
record.official_rationale: Security response to Boko Haram activity.
record.context: Inherited insurgency-related frontier restrictions; later 2021 reopening cited retrospectively.
record.uncertainty: Onset unknown. Year 2016 codes partial goods restoration only; subsequent truck/passenger phases and 2021 milestone need reconstruction. Crisis Group describes temporary opening January–June 2017; later reclosures require separate investigation.
